akashic_records.configuration.title: Akashic Records: settings
akashic_records.configuration.useProject: If ProjectE is installed, item values (EMC) are taken from it as Knowledge.
akashic_records.configuration.deriveFrom: Compute values of items without an explicit value from recipes. Not used while ProjectE values are used.
akashic_records.configuration.storageSlo: How many entries (stacks) a player's personal storage holds.
akashic_records.configuration.enchantedB: Knowledge = ((base * 10) / enchantment weight) * 2^(level - 1). Run /akashic recalc after changing.
akashic_records.configuration.unlockAllR: Unlock every crafting recipe when the player opens the book, so the recipe book shows them all.
akashic_records.configuration.hudEnabled: HUD with name and Knowledge while holding the Akashic Records book.
akashic_records.configuration.targetHudE: Second HUD with the name and cost of the item or block under the crosshair.
Screen corner or center the HUD is anchored to.
akashic_records.configuration.hudOffsetX: HUD distance from the screen edge in pixels.
akashic_records.configuration.hudOffsetY: HUD distance from the screen edge in pixels.
akashic_records.configuration.hudScale.t: Scale of the player HUD (the item HUD is a quarter smaller).
akashic_records.configuration.potionEffe: For potions without a table value: cost per minute of each effect (rounded up, doubled per amplifier level). Run /akashic recalc after changing.
akashic_records.configuration.ominousBot: Cost of a level 0 ominous bottle; each next level (up to 4) costs twice as much.
